```sql

  SELECT a.element FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id

  SELECT a.element FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id 
  JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '='
)
```
